hooks.name: quality-gate
hooks.description: Full quality gate (ruff, ruff format --check, mypy --strict, unit tests with >= 80% coverage, security tests, bandit, frontend tsc). Kiro has no pre-commit trigger, so this runs when the agent finishes a turn, and only after you confirm. Read-only. Exits 3 on failure so it never starts another agent turn.

confirm.question: Run the full quality gate (lint, types, unit and security tests, bandit)? It takes several minutes.
